_about: The estate under governance. Each system is chosen so that a different
part of the graph lights up: a conversational assistant, an Annex III
high-risk screener, and a retrieval system with a data-governance surface.

systems.name: Customer Support Assistant
systems.description: Conversational AI answering customer questions, with a Bedrock guardrail, PII redaction and an escalation path to a human agent.

systems.name: CV Screening Assistant
systems.description: Ranks job applicants against a role specification. Employment screening is EU AI Act Annex III high-risk, so Articles 9-15 genuinely apply: this is the system that makes most of the EU half of the graph real rather than hypothetical.

systems.name: Policy Document Assistant
systems.description: Retrieval-augmented assistant over an internal policy corpus, exercising data provenance, retrieval logging and corpus access control.
